## Novella/Individual Book Requirements (2026-06-02)
Every individual book in a series MUST have:
1. **Cover image** — Series-consistent design, unique per book, 2560x1600px, thumbnail-test pass
2. **Highly formatted PDF** — Professional interior via WeasyPrint/ReportLab, 6x9" trim, embedded fonts, even page count, proper margins
3. **Sales pitch at end** — Series hook + next book teaser + series reading order + complete Bob J Mills bibliography + call to action + QR codes
4. **Sales pitch must be unique per book** — Reference the specific book just finished, connect to next book, tailor to series

## Image Generation — Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (2026-05-31)
Use `google/gemini-2.5-flash-image` via OpenRouter for infographic/image generation.
- Endpoint: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions
- Returns base64 PNG in `choices[].message.images[].image_url`
- Prompt layout: "TOP SECTION (75%): [content]. BOTTOM SECTION (25%): clean dark background, NO TEXT — reserved for QR codes"
- Specify large fonts: title 52-72px, body 24-32px — must be readable on mobile

## Infographic Design Standards for Social Media (2026-05-31)
- Text sizes: Title 56-72px, Subtitle 36-44px, Headings 32-40px, Body 24-32px, Labels 20-28px
- Stats values: 48-64px bold. NEVER smaller than 18px
- QR codes in dedicated whitespace band at bottom (never overlaid on art)
- Output 4 formats: square (1080x1080), portrait (1080x1350), landscape (1200x628), story (1080x1920)
- Business books → LinkedIn. Fiction books → Facebook, X, Bluesky, Instagram, TikTok

## Last Page Manuscript Requirements (2026-05-31)
Last page of every manuscript MUST include:
1. Expanded thank-you blurb in Bob's voice (unique per book)
2. Two QR codes: mifeco.com + amazon.com/s?k=bob+j+mills
3. Expanded "more from Bob" cross-genre statement
4. Complete "Also by Bob J Mills" book list (all books to-date, organized by series)

## Current Bibliography (17 books as of 2026-05-31)
- Business (3): AI That Works, The Crisis Ready Company, Owner's Manual for AI Agents
- Age of Lightships (4): Sunward Exodus, The Mercury Accord, Ghosts Beyond Neptune, The Last Photon Fleet
- Lunar Foundation (4): Moon Rock, Mooncoming, Waters End, Waters Horizon
- No Blue Sky (5): Built from Dust, The Oxygen Gamble, Rivers Under Mars, The Red Charter, The First Martian Nation
- Memoir (1): Tomorrow Remembered
- Cindy Lou Legal Capers (3 novellas): Retainer to Trouble, Clause for Alarm, Affidavits and Alibis
- Reader Magnet: Missing Retainer Novella (Cindy Lou)
- Tomorrow is Still Open (archived memoir/novella)

## Series Sales Pitch Guidelines
Each book's end-of-book sales pitch must include:
- Series hook (3-5 sentences about the overarching story)
- Next book teaser (2-3 sentences, create urgency)
- Series reading order (numbered list with 1-line descriptions)
- Complete Bob J Mills bibliography (all series)
- Call to action + QR codes
- MUST be unique per book — reference the specific book just finished
